CHALLENGE-01.why: whoever acts on the report reads every round the same way

CHALLENGE-02.why: a section holds only findings, or None alone, so silence never reads as a pass

CHALLENGE-03.why: a deal breaker blocks only on evidence someone can re-run or re-read

CHALLENGE-04.why: a finding without its change cannot be acted on

CHALLENGE-05.why: a To decide goes to whoever owns the request, as a question
